answer: Like mycelium weaving through rich umber soil, an agent network anchors trust in symbiotic graph topology rather than bare compute. Through transitive, stake-weighted endorsement webs, establishing identity is no bedtime fable: minting forged clones collapses on a steep ledge of superlinear validation fees. Validating peripheral impostors requires exponentially compounding collateral per node, starving artificial swarms before they breach core consensus.
